message: You know that feeling when you realize you’re not quite ready for the unexpected? I’ve had my share of scrambling around the house looking for things I thought I had! 😂 It’s a good reminder that preparedness doesn’t have to be overwhelming. I found a great resource on survival kit supplies that breaks it down nicely. It’s all about keeping it simple and having a little fun while getting organized.
